title: Discord feedback triage decisions
description: Output contract for the discord-feedback-triage skill. Consumed by `vp run discord:feedback-scan -- --mode apply`, which re-validates every field against the collected bundle before anything is filed.

decisions.description: Exactly one entry per message in the bundle.

messageId.description: Must match a messageId present in the bundle. Anything else is dropped.

verdict.description: Only bug and feature become issues.

title.description: Symptom in plain words. Must be at least 8 characters for bug/feature; may be empty for question/noise/duplicate.

body.description: Markdown issue body. No HTML comments — they are stripped. Do not add a source/provenance section; the apply step adds it. Required for bug/feature.

labels.description: Labels outside this list are dropped. bug/enhancement, from-discord and user-feedback are applied automatically.

duplicateOf.description: For verdict=duplicate: a bundle messageId (in-bundle duplicate) or an existing issue URL. Null otherwise.

rationale.description: One line for the run log. Never reaches the issue.

allOf.$comment: Mirrors validateTriageResult: only filing verdicts need a usable title and a non-empty body.
